text:
Will Cuylle is getting a new job and some bad luck at the same time. Mike Sullivan has moved him to center, Newsday reported, with early reviews positive, and he has been anchoring the third line between Teuvo Tolvanen and Pavel Dorofeyev. He also has 75 hits in 18 games, which is very much his game.

Our numbers tag him as due. He has four goals on 6.2 expected, and the Rangers have scored 4.4 fewer goals than expected with him on the ice. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking says he gets a lot of shots off passes across the slot or from behind the net, the type that go in about a quarter of the time. The looks are good. The finishes aren't there yet.

Evolving-Hockey had his value last season coming mostly from defense, with opponents getting fewer chances against him than against 94% of forwards. That's exactly what you want from a third-line center. Our range has him at 15 to 27 goals over a full season after 20 last year. The position change is the story to follow.
headline: Cuylle moves to center
